description: Where the depiction takes place and how it is lit and shot. Included because a location control and a production-look control appear in effectively every commercial adult generator's interface, and because production mode materially changes the prompt: the same position rendered as 'studio professional' and as 'phone selfie' needs different lighting, lens, and grain language. Adults only.

design_notes.production_mode_is_not_style: Production mode describes the apparent capture apparatus and its consequences (lens, lighting, grain, framing discipline). It is not an art style. Art style (photoreal, anime, 3D render, painterly) is a separate concern and deliberately out of scope for this vocabulary, since it is model-specific and changes faster than a standard can track.

dimensions.scale_citation: Standard photographic lighting descriptors as applied to adult media production.
dimensions.description: The dominant light source and its quality.

values.definition: Large diffuse source; gentle shadow edges.
values.mechanical_gloss: large softbox key light, soft shadow edges, even skin rendering

values.definition: Small undiffused source; crisp shadow edges.
values.mechanical_gloss: small hard light source, sharp shadow edges, strong contrast

values.definition: Daylight through a window; directional and soft.
values.mechanical_gloss: daylight from a window to one side, soft directional falloff

values.definition: Dark field with an edge-defining backlight.
values.mechanical_gloss: dark background, rim light outlining the body, deep shadows

values.definition: Lit by lamps visible in the scene.
values.mechanical_gloss: lit by lamps within the room, warm uneven ambient light

values.definition: Saturated coloured sources.
values.mechanical_gloss: saturated coloured light from two directions, strong colour cast on skin

values.definition: Direct frontal flash; flat subject, hard background shadow.
values.mechanical_gloss: direct on-camera flash, flat frontal exposure, hard shadow on the wall behind

values.definition: Low warm flickering source.
values.mechanical_gloss: low warm flickering light from below, deep falloff

values.definition: Even shadowless illumination.
values.mechanical_gloss: flat even overcast light, minimal shadows

dimensions.scale_citation: Descriptor of the apparent capture apparatus and its photographic consequences.
dimensions.description: What the imagery appears to have been shot on and by whom. Drives lens, grain, framing discipline, and colour.

values.definition: Crewed shoot; controlled light, clean framing, full-frame lens character.
values.mechanical_gloss: professional camera, controlled studio lighting, sharp focus, clean composition

values.definition: Consumer camera, available light, imperfect framing.
values.mechanical_gloss: consumer camera, available light, slightly imperfect framing, mild noise

values.definition: Front-facing phone camera held at arm's length; wide lens distortion.
values.mechanical_gloss: front-facing phone camera at arm's length, wide-angle lens distortion, arm visible in frame

values.definition: Phone photographed in a mirror; the device is visible.
values.mechanical_gloss: photographed in a mirror, phone visible in hand, bathroom or bedroom mirror framing

values.definition: Fixed low-mounted webcam, compressed, front-lit by a screen.
values.mechanical_gloss: fixed webcam at desk height, compressed image, lit by screen glow

values.definition: Analogue grain, period colour, softer resolution.
values.mechanical_gloss: 35mm film grain, faded period colour, soft resolution

values.definition: Magazine production values; retouched, styled, deliberate.
values.mechanical_gloss: magazine editorial lighting, styled and retouched, deliberate posing

values.definition: High-mounted fixed wide camera, low frame rate, monochrome or desaturated.
values.mechanical_gloss: high fixed wide-angle camera, desaturated, low frame rate
values.policy_note: This look is strongly nonconsent-coded (hidden or covert recording). Platforms operating a consent-forward posture should exclude it. Enumerated so that it can be excluded explicitly rather than left unnamed.
